text.p: Tropical cyclone Gretelle is now moving away from the South Africa coast. The system is still a risk to shipping in the area as top winds are still at 50 mph. The system continue to weaken as it tracks southward, likely dissipated by 48 hours.

Tropical Cyclone Freda, near 27n/178e, is tracking east at 12 mph and weakening. Top winds are near 50 mph. This system remains a threat to shipping but this threat will diminish as the system weakens and dissipates over open waters by 48 hours.
Tropical Cyclone Pancho-Helinda will threaten shipping over the open Indian Ocean. The storm has 55 mph top winds and is near 11s/91e, moving southwest. It may intensify further.
There are no further statements at this time.
